reason: The lift module needs a secure, padded attachment to the frame.
expectation: The mount should fit onto the frame, ready to hold the lift module.

effect: The frame now has a mount ready for the lift module.
reaction: That was the expected first fitting.
reason: The mount should secure the balanced lift module to the whale.
expectation: The lift module should attach to the padded mount.

effect: The lift module is now attached to the whale.
reason: The exterior stop-button extension should keep the lift's stop control reachable after the whale is skinned.
expectation: The stop control should be extended to the outside of the whale.

effect: The stop-button extension cannot be fitted yet, so another part may need to go on first.
reaction: I was surprised it had no available combination yet.
reason: The paper skin is needed for the goal and may establish where the accessible fittings go.
expectation: The paper skin should cover the whale frame while leaving room for the workings.

alternatives.reason: The hatch might need to be fitted before the skin.

effect: The whale is skinned; the service hatch and exterior stop still need attention.
reason: The hatch should give access to the workings through the new skin.
expectation: The hatch should fit into the skinned whale and leave the module accessible.

effect: The hatch keeps the controller and counterweight accessible, so the exterior stop extension is the remaining fitting.
reaction: The accessible hatch makes the purpose of the fitting clear.
reason: The stop-button extension should now make the lift's stop control reachable from outside.
expectation: The extension should connect the stop control to the outside of the whale.

effect: The exterior button now reaches the stop switch, completing the skinned whale and lift-module goal. The result also explains why the battery and counterweight sit low.
reaction: The pushrod and low-mounted weight gave the final fitting a clear purpose.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the exterior stop was most worthwhile: it showed how a pushrod keeps the safety switch accessible and explained the low placement of the weight.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the mount and module was straightforward but gave little feedback about how they worked until the final result.

surprise.text: I was surprised the stop extension had no available combination before the skin and hatch were fitted.

arbitrary.text: The required order for the stop extension was not initially clear; I expected it to fit as soon as the module was mounted.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and see how the finished whale is tested, though this chapter's largely straightforward fittings were less engaging than the final explanation.
